# Verify Compilation State

This feature allows users to shadow compile against current state data without writing any changes. It checks if the current compilation state is equivalent to a fresh full compile, providing a safety net for discrepancies.

- `knowledge_compiler/compiler/run.py` — `knowledge_compiler.compiler.run.verify`
